googlePhotos.name: Google Photos
googlePhotos.description: Photos from a shared Google Photos album. Reads the public share page (there is no API), so a Google page change can break it.

fields.name: shareUrl
fields.label: Shared album link
fields.hint: In Google Photos, open the album, tap Share, create a link anyone can view and paste it here. Keep the album shared.

fields.name: counterStateKey
fields.label: Optional state key for persistence
fields.hint: Keeps the photo position across restarts.

fields.name: fitMode
fields.label: Fit mode
fields.hint: cover crops the photo to fill the frame, contain shows all of it.

fields.name: saveAssets
fields.label: Save asset
fields.hint: Save each photo in the frame's assets folder. auto saves when the frame is set to save assets.

fields.name: cacheAlbumSeconds
fields.label: Album cache duration (seconds)
fields.hint: How long to reuse the album's photo list. New photos show up within this time.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Google Photos",
  "description": "Photos from a shared Google Photos album. Reads the public share page (there is no API), so a Google page change can break it.",
  "category": "data",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "shareUrl",
      "type": "text",
      "value": "",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Shared album link",
      "placeholder": "https://photos.app.goo.gl/...",
      "hint": "In Google Photos, open the album, tap Share, create a link anyone can view and paste it here. Keep the album shared."
    },
    {
      "name": "mode",
      "type": "select",
      "options": ["random", "sequential"],
      "value": "random",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Order of images"
    },
    {
      "name": "counterStateKey",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Optional state key for persistence",
      "hint": "Keeps the photo position across restarts.",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "mode", "operator": "eq", "value": "sequential" }]
    },
    {
      "name": "fitMode",
      "type": "select",
      "options": ["cover", "contain"],
      "value": "cover",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Fit mode",
      "hint": "cover crops the photo to fill the frame, contain shows all of it."
    },
    {
      "name": "metadataStateKey",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Metadata state key",
      "hint": "Stores {source, index, count, imageUrl}."
    },
    {
      "name": "saveAssets",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "auto",
      "options": ["auto", "always", "never"],
      "label": "Save asset",
      "hint": "Save each photo in the frame's assets folder. auto saves when the frame is set to save assets."
    },
    {
      "name": "cacheAlbumSeconds",
      "type": "integer",
      "value": "3600",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Album cache duration (seconds)",
      "placeholder": "3600",
      "hint": "How long to reuse the album's photo list. New photos show up within this time."
    }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }],
  "cache": { "enabled": true, "inputEnabled": true, "durationEnabled": true, "duration": "900" }
}
